# body-muscles artwork (vendored)

`regions.json` contains the SVG path data (ids, names, views, `d` strings) of **body-muscles** by Ivan Vulovic
(https://github.com/vulovix/body-muscles), licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` in this folder).

Modifications: the path data was extracted from `src/data/muscles.front.ts` and `src/data/muscles.back.ts` and converted to JSON.
The path strings themselves are unchanged. Everything else in this app (rendering, region-to-muscle mapping, states, accessibility) is original code.
